posts.title: Hunting of the Wren
posts.description: Obsessed with this song. It’s based on the true 19th-century history of the “Wrens of the Curragh“. I saw Radie Peat last night at Union Chapel as she was kicking off the tour for her solo album ” No Human Tongue Can Tell” and I am still shaken. That voice and her stories!

posts.title: Welcoming Silona Bonewald to MetaBrainz
posts.description: Six months ago I wrote about Rob Kaye’s death and what it would take to keep MetaBrainz alive without him. It was a job posting wearing a eulogy’s clothes. Today I get to write the sequel.
